section: ER-02 Site conditions and design data
text: HVAC and cooling design: summer 0.4 % 32.8 degC / 48 % RH; freeze protection and heating: winter 99.6 % -4.8 degC; performance test ambient range 5 degC to 30 degC (ALP-OWN-MET-001 sections 3 and 7). Heat tracing for all outdoor water-filled lines and instruments.
